verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents a Feature Flags API that assigns users to variants for experiments, rollouts, and releases, and its homepage mentions running rollouts, so it has its own feature-flag capability. Nothing in the pack shows flag targeting by user properties, cohorts, or percentage rollouts; the cohort mention concerns analytics grouping, not flag targeting. missing for 10: documented targeting by user properties, cohort-based flag targeting, percentage-rollout configuration, SDK flag evaluation details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can roll out features behind flags targeted by user properties, cohorts, and percentage rollouts

citations.quote: Use the Feature Flags API to assign your users to variants for experiments, rollout, and releases.
designing, running, and analyzing tests and rollouts in the same place you do all your analytics
